heading: Powers and obligations of the Board; liability of members
lead: Except as otherwise provided by this chapter, the Board shall have all the usual powers and obligations of a trustee with respect to property and funds administered by it, but the members of the Board are not personally liable, except for malfeasance.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on 44 U.S. Code, 1964 ed., § 300ff (July 9, 1941, ch. 284, § 6, 55 Stat. 582).

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1984—Pub. L. 98–497 amended section generally, inserting “Except as otherwise provided by this chapter,”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1984 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 98–497 effective Apr. 1, 1985, see section 301 of Pub. L. 98–497, set out as a note under section 2102 of this title.
